newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel says reassures Arafat on settler project.
newsitem.headline: Israel says reassures Arafat on settler project.

text.p: Israel has told Palestinian President Yasser Arafat that it will block construction of a Jewish settler enclave in the heart of Arab East Jerusalem "at this time", a senior official said on Friday.
David Bar-Illan, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's communications chief, said Arafat received the assurance in a telephone call on Thursday night from an aide to the Israeli leader, Yitzhak Molho.
